literal: Nakedness covering? Folly, in oneself fault not-covering when.
translation: What is the use of covering one's physical nakedness? It is mere folly, when one fails to cover the faults within oneself.
modern: தன்னிடம் உள்ள குற்றங்களை நீக்கி மறைக்காத போது, உடலின் மறைவிடங்களை மட்டும் ஆடையால் மறைப்பது அறியாமையாகும்.
explanation: The couplet contrasts physical modesty with moral modesty. The word 'அற்றம்' refers to physical nakedness, while 'குற்றம்' refers to moral flaws. The poet points out the hypocrisy of covering one's body with clothes while leaving one's inner faults exposed and uncorrected. Maintaining outward decency without hiding and curing one's own flaws is sheer folly.
